competitiveAdvantages.title: Network Effects
competitiveAdvantages.description: Microsoft's vast user base on its Office and Windows platforms generates significant network effects, making it more valuable to users as more join.

competitiveAdvantages.title: Ecosystem Lock-in
competitiveAdvantages.description: The integration of Microsoft products across devices creates high switching costs for customers due to the complexity of transitioning to a new ecosystem.

competitiveAdvantages.title: Brand Recognition
competitiveAdvantages.description: Microsoft's strong brand presence and recognition in the tech industry provides a competitive advantage, making it easier to attract top talent and invest in research and development.

investmentRisks.title: Competition from Cloud Giants
investmentRisks.description: Microsoft faces intense competition from cloud computing giants such as Amazon and Google.

investmentRisks.title: Regulatory Scrutiny in EU
investmentRisks.description: The company must navigate complex EU regulations regarding data privacy and antitrust laws.

investmentRisks.title: Dependence on Enterprise Segment
investmentRisks.description: A significant portion of Microsoft's revenue comes from enterprise software sales, which can be cyclical and subject to disruption.
